buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses M&L for carrying out the laboratory test/filed test for soil investigation work in any type of soil/rock/boulde rs/hard dense soil submittting the report in six copy complete bounded in hard copy and two CD as soft co py displaying CA No/Job No and name of work- :- (i) Drilling 150 mm bore holes down to various depth or r efusal whichever is encounted earlier below ground to depth down to 10 mtr or refusal whichever is encou ntered earlier. (ii) Collecting distrub ed and undisturbed sample of soil. (iii) Conducting standard penetration test as per relevant IS code-2131 (iv) Recording water level in accordance with IS Code 1892 and IS Code 8935. (v) Conducting liquid limit, plastic limit shrinkage limit test and find out sulphate content for sample encounted in the starata with IS 2720 part XXVII. (vi) Carrying out Hydrometric, sieve analysis test, index properties as per IS 2720 relevent part and IS 3104 respectively. (vi i) Conducting test to determine soil bearing capacities ( Ultimate, gross, net and net safe) as per relevant I S code. (viii) Liquifaction Analysis report under Seismic loads. (ix) Report consisting of the bore log properties of the soil of each starta suggesting for the depth type of the foundation and bearing c apacity of the soil & technical details and recommendation for footing of S+3 Block as required. (x) The Soil investigation must be carried out at the location complete all as directed by Engr-in-Charge. Soil investigation/testing shall be done as per late st relvant IS code complete all as specified and directed by Engr-in-Charge. M&L for carrying out plate load test as per IS 1888 using gravity loading method (plate size 300x300) to d etermine the following soil parameters: allowable bearing pressure, settlement, modulus of elasticity, mod ulus of subgrade reaction, and ultimate bearing capacity for foundation design of multistory bldgs, checkin g the suitability of materials under load and suggest suitable design of foundation for Bdlg Testing shall be done as per latest relvant IS code complete all as specified and directed by Engr-in-Charge. Vetting report : All six copies of the soil testing report are to be govt vetted from any indian institute of Te chnology (III) National Institute of Technology (NIT)/ Government Engineering College. Note:- (i) Depth of borehole for sites/ areas with every low bearing capacity can be increased further based on sit e requirements. (ii) SPT is required to be ta ken out every 1m internal or at every change in strata. (iii) Safe Bearing Capacity evaluated based on shear failure and settlement failure crit erion as per IS : 8009(Pt-I)-1976, IS:2720 (Py-II)-1980, IS:6403-1981, IS : 1904-1986 & IS: 1080-1985 and o ther relevant IS codes and detailed calculations duly showing the various soil perimeters indices shall be gi

ven in the soil report. (iv) Recommendation for e conimal width and type of foundation to be adopted, shall be given in the report. (v) Six copies of ink signed test reports with soft copies in CD. Should be submitted with detailed descriptio n of field investgation carried out, soil classification and general nature of soil strata, water table, interpret ation of test results, grain size distribution curves, compressive index curves, site plan etc as listed in prec eding paragraphs. (vi) Photographic reco rd of geo-explorations as well as testing shall also form the part of the report. GPS camera/Time stamp cam eras must be used for photographic records & its authenticity. (vii) Every page of the Soil Investigation report should have the Name of the Job for which soil Investigation is b eing carried out with serial Nos along with site identification in case of multiple sites of a report pertaining to the site alongwith the name of the job. (viii) Site cleara nce: Vendors/ bidders are advised to visit the site before submission of their quotas. Any site clearance wo rk including making approaches requried to complete the soil testing jobs will be responsibilty of successfu l L-1 vendor/bidder and nothing extra will be admissible on this account. .
